A held plan stays quarantined until an operator calls rebind_plan_owner(plan_id, incident_id, actor=..., reason=...) after preview_rebind(); targets must be open and a recorded owner candidate unless allow_non_candidate=True. An ordinary PLAN does not re-establish a lost owner.
